doc.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing thanks
summary: Brower thanks Cobb and closes the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: . . . for sharing so much of yourself and your time and your wife and your daughters and just rummaging through your life and being so lucid and transparent about it.
I’m surprised that I remembered that much.
It’s a great gift to the American people.

And I think it’s going to be important for generations to come to be able to live through these moments with you and to understand what it is, in a first person kind of way, as a witness you’ve been. So, all that being said, I think we’re at the end of the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History interview with the great Jimmy Cobb.
Thank you, sir. I appreciate it.
